kv_store_centralized_mooncake.name: kv_store_centralized_mooncake
kv_store_centralized_mooncake.label: Centralized (standalone store)
kv_store_centralized_mooncake.description: Multi-instance vLLM cluster with shared centralized KV cache via MooncakeStoreConnector in standalone-store mode. A dedicated mooncake_store_service process owns the entire CPU DRAM pool; vLLM GPUs contribute zero local memory (global_segment_size=0 per GPU). A vllm-router with cache_aware policy routes requests so prefix- matched prompts land on the same instance — maximizing KV cache hits. Decouples cache capacity from vLLM lifecycle — store survives vLLM restarts. Recommended for production deployments with large cache pools.

mooncake_master.command:
# Reachable by every instance and the store as $MOONCAKE_MASTER_IP:50051.
# 30s KV lease; eviction starts at 95% pool usage and frees 10% per pass.
mooncake_master \
  -rpc_port=50051 \
  -rpc_thread_num=4 \
  -default_kv_lease_ttl=30000 \
  -eviction_high_watermark_ratio=0.95 \
  -eviction_ratio=0.1 \
  -logtostderr
mooncake_master.description: Lightweight metadata coordinator. One instance per cluster.

mooncake_store_config.description: Centralized CPU DRAM pool — registers global_segment_size per store node and survives vLLM restarts.
mooncake_store_config.note:
global_segment_size here IS per node (not per GPU) — size it to each
store node's RAM. device_name "" auto-selects the store node's RDMA NICs.

mooncake_vllm_config.note:
Same file on every instance node. Each GPU donates no memory
(global_segment_size 0 per GPU) — capacity lives in the store service.
device_name "" auto-selects RDMA NICs by GPU-NIC PCIe/NUMA affinity.

kv_store_distributed_mooncake.name: kv_store_distributed_mooncake
kv_store_distributed_mooncake.label: Distributed (embedded)
kv_store_distributed_mooncake.description: Mooncake KV cache in embedded mode — each GPU contributes CPU DRAM (global_segment_size) to the cache pool. A single instance uses it as a CPU offload tier; at 2+ instances a cache_aware vllm-router shares the pool, routing prefix-matched prompts to the same instance. A lightweight mooncake_master coordinates the pool; no separate store process needed.

mooncake_master.command:
# Reachable by every instance as $MOONCAKE_MASTER_IP:50051.
# 30s KV lease; eviction starts at 95% pool usage and frees 10% per pass.
mooncake_master \
  -rpc_port=50051 \
  -rpc_thread_num=4 \
  -default_kv_lease_ttl=30000 \
  -eviction_high_watermark_ratio=0.95 \
  -eviction_ratio=0.1 \
  -logtostderr
mooncake_master.description: Lightweight metadata coordinator. One instance per cluster.

mooncake_vllm_config.note:
Same file on every instance node. global_segment_size is per GPU (not per
node) — size it so the total across all GPUs fits in the host RAM you can pin.
device_name "" auto-selects RDMA NICs by GPU-NIC PCIe/NUMA affinity.
